physics_goals.quote: The MAJORANA DEMONSTRATOR searched for neutrinoless double-β decay (0νββ) of 76Ge
physics_goals.value: Search for neutrinoless double-beta decay of 76Ge and demonstrate the technology needed for a future tonne-scale germanium experiment (LEGEND)

summary.plain: A demonstration experiment nearly a mile underground in a former South Dakota gold mine, using germanium crystals to search for a rare radioactive process. It proved the low-background techniques later scaled up in the LEGEND experiment.
summary.technical: MAJORANA DEMONSTRATOR: array of modular p-type point-contact HPGe detector arrays (up to 40.4 kg total, 27.2 kg enriched to ~88% in 76Ge) in vacuum cryostats, located in the Davis Campus at the 4850 Level (1478 m) of SURF. Installation began March 2012; final result accumulated 64.5 kg·yr of enriched exposure and set T1/2 0ν > 8.3×10²⁵ yr (90% C.L.). Its techniques and personnel carried into LEGEND.

unique_capabilities.quote: modular arrays of high-purity Ge detectors operated in vacuum cryostats in a low-background shield
unique_capabilities.value: World-leading energy resolution among 0νββ experiments, achieved with p-type point-contact HPGe detectors in electroformed-copper vacuum cryostats
